member.name: Normalize
member.para: What a greedy left-to-right scan cost. On "Die Cyber-Brutzellen" (2026-08-01) chapter 14's announcement at 7:01:30 was read as 40, and chapters 15 through 29 - every one of them detected, refined and correctly placed - then failed "greater than 40" one after another and were discarded: a 17 h audiobook came out marked as far as 6:21 and no further.
